description: This file contains a C program that patches a Device Tree Blob (DTB) into a kernel image by searching for a specific marker ('OWRTDTB:') and replacing or inserting the DTB data at that point. It includes functions for file handling, memory mapping, and data copying, aimed at modifying firmware or kernel images with device tree information.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char ** argv)
methods.description: Main function to patch the Device Tree Blob (DTB) into the kernel image. Processes command-line arguments, opens files, maps them into memory, searches for a marker, and copies the DTB data into the kernel image.
